verdict.rationale: Kling documents API credentials (an AccessKey + SecretKey pair used for JWT authentication), but nothing shows those credentials can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent. Plain key-pair authentication is adjacent to the story, not the capability itself. missing for 10: scoped or least-privilege key issuance, per-agent credentials, permission or role restrictions on API keys, key rotation or revocation controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
